extracted.name: Pork Sinigang
extracted.description: Sinigang is a Filipino soup cooked with pork. It is easy to make with tangy, fresh flavors from tamarind, ginger, and tomato — in a rich pork broth.
ingredient_lines: 1 (1.41 ounce) package tamarind soup base (such as Knorr®)
instruction_lines: Heat vegetable oil in a skillet over medium heat. Add onion; cook and stir until softened and translucent, about 5 minutes. Season with salt.
Stir in ginger, tomatoes, and pork chops. Cover and reduce heat to medium-low. Turn the pork occasionally, until browned.
Pour in water and tamarind soup base. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat and simmer until the pork is tender and cooked through, about 30 minutes.
Stir in green beans and cook until tender.
